bug_semantics: Every unauthenticated WebSocket connection follows the default connection listener into requestClientId and rpc.send('get-client-id'); a silent client leaves both the queued RPC request and its 10 ms setInterval alive after socket close, so repeated connections cause unbounded timer, CPU, and heap growth.
flaw_origin: Single-parent commit f5d03cac30baa3f9d066095962e08df3c61112ce is the smallest surviving public object that first coupled the default client-ID request path to an RPC implementation that queues every reply-bearing request and polls forever without timeout or socket-close cleanup.
evidence: The CVE.org CNA record is PUBLISHED and describes the unauthenticated get-client-id RPC waiter leak as fixed in 0.2.16; the bundled GHSA is not withdrawn.

The f5d03cac30baa3f9d066095962e08df3c61112ce diff adds RPC.requests/responses, this.requests.push(payload), and setInterval polling whose only clearInterval/queue cleanup path requires a matching response; it also changes the default connection path to await requestClientId({ws,rpc}). Its new clientId.js explicitly notes that missing timeout could queue unactioned promises and become a DoS vector.

Immediate parent d5cb93d5d6f5b7d8e77c998cf74125383d95232b has no lib/clientId.js and its RPC implementation has no requests queue, response waiter, or setInterval; its client-ID request is a plain WebSocket send, so the vulnerable resource-retention mechanism is absent.

The BIC has exactly one parent, no local pull/member refs, and ordinary author and committer metadata for Paul Jensen dated 2020-10-12; its message and raw commit metadata contain no AI-generation or Co-Authored-By marker. No finer public member is available, so no squash decomposition is applicable.
Commit 990461ee58370b5f1cc2c2c2f1efd827a08cecbd later copies the already-vulnerable JavaScript waiter into src/lib/rpc.ts during TypeScript conversion and is a migration, not the BIC.

In parent 6c97a4f2c5d0e69881c5d5710a17e60ca1dc37ec the TypeScript waiter still clears its interval and removes its request only after a reply. Direct fix 931576db3cdbf4f1583bd2c3c8759c4f4e032ab3 passes ws into waitForReply, installs a once('close') handler, clears the interval, removes the pending request, and rejects the waiter.

Tag ancestry excludes the BIC from v0.0.2 and includes it in v0.0.3; it excludes the direct fix from v0.2.15 and includes it in v0.2.16. Commit 67260d2a1407a77f082f02dc9e1f0891222c306d changes package metadata from 0.2.15 to 0.2.16 and is the release carrier, while 931576db3cdbf4f1583bd2c3c8759c4f4e032ab3 is the direct fix.
reasoning: The real advisory is confirmed, the source-to-sink mechanism is present, the immediate-parent absence check identifies f5d03cac30baa3f9d066095962e08df3c61112ce rather than the later TypeScript migration or release carrier, and the direct repair is independently mapped. AI attribution is evaluated only on that BIC: the 2020 single-parent commit has named matching human author/committer metadata and no AI marker or AI co-author trailer. Therefore the vulnerability is human-introduced and the closed verdict is NOT_AI.
